omni-text-to-image.steps: Deploy image or video API → Text To Image → pick the model → Deploy with vLLM Omni → Next → Create.

omni-image-to-image.steps: Deploy image or video API → Image To Image → pick the model → Deploy with vLLM Omni → Next → Create.

omni-text-to-video.steps: Deploy image or video API → Text To Video → pick the model → Deploy with vLLM Omni → Next → Create.

omni-image-to-video.steps: Deploy image or video API → Image To Video → pick the model → Deploy with vLLM Omni → Next → Create.
